name: scroll-tabs
title: Scroll Tabs
description: Tabs over swipeable pages: the underline follows the swipe and stretches between tabs as labels brighten.

perf.budget: Two native scroll views; the underline and labels read the page scroll offset on the UI thread. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Tapping a tab jumps to its page instead of scrolling.
a11y.screenReader: A tab list whose tabs have a selected state; only the current page is exposed.
a11y.touchTarget: Tabs are 48 pt tall and as wide as their label plus 32 pt.
